deltas.delta: Lagoon cannot be rehearsed through eth_call on this chain's endpoints. cleared.check: Opcode battery (99,985 vectors) and targeted set (85,544 vectors, MULMOD and mulDiv at the ruint 1.21.0 fault condition, ADDMOD at overflow, division by full width divisors, shifts at every limb boundary) at the builds the endpoints report on 2026-11-27.
cleared.result: Every vector on all seven chains returns the specified word. The pool math of FullMath (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24, 48, 112), the sign masks of TickMath and SqrtPriceMath (src/libraries/TickMath.sol:61-63, src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:219), the signed division of TickBitmap (src/libraries/TickBitmap.sol:20-26, 54-67) and the byte tables of BitMath (src/libraries/BitMath.sol:22, 45) therefore see Ethereum results.

cleared.check: The deployed PoolManager bytecode under one state on each chain: pmdiff set 1 (250 scripts of pool math) and set 2 (300 scripts of hook, token and native call paths).
cleared.result: 550 of 550 scripts give the Ethereum reference bytes on all seven chains, including the revert selectors of the error paths.

cleared.check: Mined swaps of the newest window on each chain against the tick relation and the single-step formulas, and the multi-step ones replayed through the Pool.swap loop from storage at their block.
cleared.result: 9,192 swaps satisfy the tick relation with no mismatch; 6,883 of 6,982 paired swaps match one step to the unit; 73 of 99 multi-step swaps were replayed through the whole loop and all 73 match, the longest with 19 steps on Base. Block production therefore computed the source's math on these chains.

cleared.check: New Base tags v1.6.0-rc.8 and rc.9: interpreter, integer library and precompile wrapper.
cleared.result: The rc.9 lockfile equals rc.7 apart from checksums (revm-interpreter 43.0.2, ruint 1.19.0), and macros.rs with the is_direct_call check equals v1.5.6. Nothing on the arithmetic or jump path changes.

cleared.check: Lead L-360 at block 62,840,912: DELEGATECALL and CALLCODE to a B20 token, the B20 factory and the Policy Registry from a frame whose msg.sender is the PoolManager, as a hook or unlock callback would make (src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134, src/PoolManager.sol:104-110, src/types/Currency.sol:48).
cleared.result: All six calls fail with DelegateCallNotAllowed (0x0d89438e). A direct call takes the calling contract as the source. The 6,063,615.406041 OUSD the PoolManager holds cannot be moved by an account that only gets the PoolManager to call its contract.

cleared.check: Lagoon execution change for the PoolManager: lower input limits for BLS12-381 G1 MSM, G2 MSM and pairing.
cleared.result: src/ never builds input for these precompiles. The only way the PoolManager reaches one is a native take or a hook call to its address with data the caller chose (src/types/Currency.sol:48, src/libraries/Hooks.sol:134), and a smaller limit can only turn a call that succeeded into one that fails, which reverts that caller's own unlock. No opcode changes.

cleared.check: Client releases since cycle 29 that could change the interpreter: op-reth v2.10.1, v2.10.2, v2.10.0-rc.5 and v2.11.0-rc.1, world-chain v2.8.4, v2.9.0-rc.2 and v2.9.0, Base v1.5.7, v1.6.0 and rc.10.
cleared.result: None of these tags exists on raw.githubusercontent.com (HTTP 404), and every endpoint reports the same build string as in cycle 29. The superchain-registry files for all seven chains are byte identical to the ones cycle 29 read.

leadResults.answer: No public World Chain endpoint serves eth_simulateV1 with a build name. Alchemy public names world-chain/v2.8.2-9596311 but answers 'Only core evm requests are allowed', thirdweb names thirdweb/1.0 and fails, drpc names Geth/v10.0.0/drpc and fails with a temporary error, and the Tenderly gateways answer nothing. The single-call sets (185,529 vectors and 550 scripts) match there again this cycle. The lead is carried forward at low priority.

The build still answers only op-reth/v0.0.0-dev-unknown on mainnet.optimism.io and rpc-qnd.inkonchain.com, and github.com and the GitHub API are not reachable, so its commit cannot be named. It again returns the specified word for all battery and targeted vectors and all 550 scripts. New fact: with a block time override past lagoon_time it still accepts an 818 pair G1 MSM input, so the time override does not switch its fork rules, which leaves its Lagoon code untested through RPC.

At Base v1.5.6, block 62,840,912, DELEGATECALL and CALLCODE from a PoolManager-called frame to OUSD, the B20 factory and the Policy Registry all fail with DelegateCallNotAllowed, and a direct call takes the calling contract as source. The newest tags v1.6.0-rc.8 and rc.9 keep macros.rs with the is_direct_call check unchanged. The check stays a per-release item for Base.
